orders.title: Sales orders
orders.subtitle: Reserve units for a customer and complete the sale when shipped
orders.reserved_until_hint: If left empty, the reservation does not expire (unless the company sets default days).
orders.complete_msg: The {{count}} units will become “Sold”. This cannot be undone.
orders.cancel_msg: Reserved units will become available again.
orders.no_items_hint: Use the tabs above to search available units or add them by quantity.
orders.no_available: No available units match those filters
orders.auto_hint: Say what you need and how many; the system reserves the oldest available units that match. If there are not enough, it reserves none.
orders.off_alert: {{count}} added unit(s) do not match what was ordered (type, specs or grade, or the line was already complete). You may keep them, but please check.
orders.complete_missing: {{count}} unit(s) are still missing according to the order lines.
orders.complete_off: {{count}} unit(s) do not match the order.

lines.empty: This order has no lines yet
lines.empty_hint: Say what is being sold by type, specs and grade (no codes). Then add the units picked from the rack by code.
lines.hint: Leave "Any" for what does not matter. Example: Laptop · Dell · grade A or B · 20 units.
lines.fill_hint: Automatically reserve the oldest available units still missing for this line
lines.fill_none: There are no available units for this line
lines.delete_msg: The line is removed from the order.
lines.delete_msg_items: The {{count}} unit(s) already added stay in the order but will be marked as "does not match".

pick.title: Add units picked from the rack
pick.hint: Scan or type the codes (or serial numbers) of the units you took from the rack, one per line. The system compares them with the order lines and warns you if any does not match, but they are still added.
pick.off_toast: {{count}} do not match the order (added anyway)
pick.warn_title: Warning! {{count}} unit(s) are not as ordered
pick.warn_hint: They were added anyway. Check that this is right or remove them from the order.
pick.hint_one: Scan or type the code (or serial number) and press Enter: each unit is added instantly and the cursor stays ready for the next one.
pick.paste_manual: The browser does not allow reading the clipboard here: paste with Ctrl+V in the box.

loc.none_picked: No units in the order yet
loc.pending_title: Where to find what is missing

pl.detail_hint: One row per unit, with code and serial number.
pl.summary_hint: Grouped by type, description and grade, with quantities.

quick.title: Quick sale
quick.subtitle: Sell equipment without creating an order: just add the units. Customer details are optional.
quick.hint: Scan or type a code and press Enter. You can also paste many codes at once (e.g. copied from Inventory) and all are added.
quick.already_in_list: Those units are already in the list.
quick.empty: No units in the list yet
quick.empty_hint: Scan, type or paste codes above.
quick.optional_hint: Customer, price and notes — only if you need them.
quick.footer_hint: The sale is recorded immediately and the units become Sold.
quick.confirm_msg: The units become Sold and leave their location. A quick-sale record is created.
quick.no_permission: You do not have permission to make quick sales.

qty.title: Available, grouped ({{count}} units)
qty.hint: Type how many units you want from each group, without choosing codes: the oldest are taken first.

orders.needs_lines_title: First define which equipment the order includes
orders.needs_lines_msg: Units cannot be added to an order with no lines. Add at least one line (type, specs and quantity) in the order-lines tab.

labels.title: Shipping labels — {{code}}
labels.no_template: There is no order label template. Create one in Settings → Labels → New document label.
labels.hint: One label per package, with the customer, weight and size of each. The details are saved in the order so you can reprint.
labels.hint_readonly: One label per package. You do not have permission to save these details in the order.
labels.preview_of: Preview: package {{n}} of {{total}} (tap a row to see it)
